description: Creates a point-in-time snapshot of a volume, so its current contents can be restored later. Use before anything destructive — a delete, a risky job, a version bump — and when the user wants a checkpoint they can return to. The snapshot is new stored data and bills per GB-month like the volume it came from. Not idempotent: each call creates another snapshot and snapshots are billed for storage. List the volume's snapshots before retrying.
name: snapshot_volume
